caveats.efficiency: Both references give efficiency as a PEAK or single figure, and both curves live in FIGURES (TIDA Figure 2-x; UM3564 Figure 47) that text extraction cannot recover as per-point data. Only the headline numbers are usable here.
caveats.device_library: pwrlab's device library is REPRESENTATIVE, not the parts these designs use. An efficiency comparison therefore tests the loss MODEL and its order of magnitude, not a specific part's datasheet.
caveats.unmodelled_loss: The model accounts for device conduction and switching loss only. Magnetics (core and copper), gate-drive power, control power, EMI filter loss and busbar resistance are all absent, so the model must be OPTIMISTIC on efficiency by construction.
caveats.switching_frequency: TIDA-01606 runs at 50-90 kHz. Simulating a three-phase leg at 50 kHz with a 50 Hz fundamental costs mf=1000 carrier cycles per run; the criteria below are evaluated on a frequency sweep and its trend rather than at a single unaffordable point.
